AT0046.title: Ranking Manipulation Tools
AT0046.description: Ranking manipulation tools manufacture fraudulent clicks, views, downloads, installs, reviews, and other ranking signals. Common delivery models include human-powered engagement farming and automated engagement farming. Human-powered operations pay real workers to complete specified searches, downloads, or interactions on physical devices, producing behavior closer to legitimate users at a higher cost. Automated operations use protocol emulation, scripts, emulators, cloud phones, or device farms together with device spoofing, proxy networks, and randomized behavior to evade platform controls.
